# LearnHub

> LearnHub is a learning management platform where teachers manage courses, students, live classes and exams, and students enroll in courses and track their progress.

## Pages

- [Home](https://yourapp.vercel.app/): Landing page
- [Dashboard](https://yourapp.vercel.app/dashboard): Teacher/student dashboard
- [Courses](https://yourapp.vercel.app/courses): Browse and manage courses
